_about: Infrastructure and custodian addresses met across audits. HINTS, not facts: labels.py re-verifies the cheap properties (code, nonce) live, and pitfall #22 still applies — prove an address on the chain you are on before resting a conclusion on it. Never add an issuer, a market maker or anything that identifies an audited project here; this file is shared by every audit.

0x000000000000000000000000000000000000de.label: burn address
0x000000000000000000000000000000000000de.evidence: no private key; exclude from the float as burn

0x6aba0315493b7e6989041c91181337b662fb1b.verify: flows concentrated on the Alpha vault
